tech.name: Copilot Workspaces
tech.released: 2026-11-17 at Microsoft Ignite 2026; available in Frontier (Microsoft's early access program)
tech.status: early access (Frontier) only; not generally available
tech.one_line: A shared space in the Copilot app, the evolution of Copilot Notebooks, where people and agents work toward a common goal with shared context: an agent drafts a section of a document and you review; you leave a comment and an agent picks it up; the collaboration continues in Microsoft Teams.

predecessor.name: Single-player AI at work: each person chats with Copilot alone and copies its answer into a shared document by hand (Microsoft: 'mostly single player'; the copy-paste scene and the counted example are the episode's own); predecessor product: Copilot Notebooks

claims.text: Until now, AI interactions have mostly been single player
Workspaces makes it a truly multiplayer experience, where people and agents drive towards a common goal, with shared context
Workspaces is the evolution of Copilot Notebooks
An agent drafts a section of a document, and you review
You leave a comment, and an agent picks it up
It is in the Copilot app; the collaboration continues in Microsoft Teams
Workspaces is now available in Frontier (announced Nov 17, 2026 at Ignite)
Frontier gives early access to preview AI features before they're generally available; needs a Microsoft 365 Copilot license and the organisation's opt-in
Nadella: from a single player world to a true multiplayer form factor, people, their agents and other people driving towards a common goal with shared context: Copilot Workspaces
Our example (invented): a 4-part team plan; before, 4 parts pasted in by hand from solo chats (4 copy-pastes); now agents draft in the plan and you review (0 copy-pastes). Microsoft gives no count
